## Azure Database for MariaDB  
  
<!--97c5d103-0ef7-4463-80a9-23413d01101c_begin-->

#### Azure Database for MariaDB is retiring.
  
The platform encourages you to transition to Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server before the retirement date to experience the new capabilities of Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server.
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions and use new capabilities.

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Azure updates](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=azure-database-for-mariadb-will-be-retired-on-19-september-2025-migrate-to-azure-database-for-mysql-flexible-server).
